_comment: The personality inventory Lore offers beside a chart (Services/InventoryService.cs): the IPIP-NEO-120 (Johnson, 2014), 120 statements measuring the five broad traits of the Five-Factor Model and 30 narrower facets, four statements to a facet. The statements and their scoring keys are from the International Personality Item Pool (ipip.ori.org) and are in the public domain; they are given here word for word and in Johnson's order and must not be reworded, or the reference figures no longer apply. The descriptions of each trait and facet are Lore's own. Nothing here has anything to do with astrology.

instrument.name: IPIP-NEO-120
instrument.author: John A. Johnson (2014), from the International Personality Item Pool
instrument.licence: Public domain: the IPIP states that permission is already granted to anyone to use its items for any purpose.
instrument.prompt: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future, and as you honestly see yourself beside other people of your own sex and roughly your own age. Each statement begins, in effect, with "I".
instrument.norms: Kajonius & Johnson (2019), Assessing the structure of the Five Factor Model of Personality (IPIP-NEO-120) in the public domain, Europe's Journal of Psychology 15(2): means and standard deviations for 320,128 people who took the questionnaire on the internet (127,695 men and 192,433 women, average age 28).

_scoring_comment: Each answer counts 1 to 5 in the order of `choices`, or 5 to 1 for a statement marked reversed. A facet is the sum of its four statements (4 to 20); a trait is the average of its six facets. `mean` and `sd` are the reference figures on those scales. A score more than one standard deviation below the mean is described with `low`, more than one above with `high`, and anything between with `typical`.

domains.name: Neuroticism
domains.about: How readily a person feels distress: worry, anger, low mood, self-consciousness, temptation and strain. The name is the standard one and is not a judgment; a high score describes sensitivity, not illness.
domains.low: Emotionally steady. Upsets are few and soon over, and stress leaves little mark.
domains.typical: Feels the ordinary range of worry, irritation and low mood, and recovers from them at an ordinary pace.
domains.high: Feels things keenly. Worry, irritation or discouragement come easily and take time to settle.

domains.name: Extraversion
domains.about: How much a person is drawn to other people, to activity and to excitement, and how readily good spirits show.
domains.low: Reserved and self-contained. Prefers quiet, a few people and a slower pace, and does not need much stimulation.
domains.typical: Enjoys company and enjoys time alone, in roughly equal measure.
domains.high: Outgoing, lively and energetic. Seeks out people and activity and is cheered by both.

domains.name: Openness to Experience
domains.about: How far a person's interest runs to imagination, art, feeling, novelty and ideas, as against the familiar and the practical.
domains.low: Practical and down to earth. Prefers the familiar and the proven to the new and the abstract.
domains.typical: Has some taste for new ideas and experiences without going out of the way for them.
domains.high: Curious and imaginative. Drawn to ideas, art, variety and the life of the mind.

domains.name: Agreeableness
domains.about: How a person deals with others: with trust, frankness, helpfulness, give-and-take, modesty and sympathy, or with their opposites.
domains.low: Tough-minded and independent. Puts own interests and judgment first and does not mind a disagreement.
domains.typical: Generally considerate and co-operative, and able to stand firm when it matters.
domains.high: Warm, considerate and accommodating. Thinks well of people and goes out of the way for them.

domains.name: Conscientiousness
domains.about: How a person handles tasks and impulses: confidence, order, duty, ambition, persistence and care before acting.
domains.low: Easy-going and spontaneous. Not much bound by plans, schedules or rules, and inclined to act on the moment.
domains.typical: Reasonably organised and reliable, without being driven by it.
domains.high: Organised, dependable and determined. Plans ahead, keeps commitments and sees things through.

facets.name: Anxiety
facets.measures: Worry and fearfulness.
facets.low: Seldom worries. Stays calm when things are uncertain and is not easily frightened.
facets.typical: Worries about as much as most people do, when there is something to worry about.
facets.high: Worries a good deal. Often tense or apprehensive, and inclined to expect the worst.

facets.name: Anger
facets.measures: How easily irritation and anger are felt (not how they are shown).
facets.low: Slow to anger. Annoyances are let pass and tempers rarely rise.
facets.typical: Gets annoyed now and then, as most people do.
facets.high: Quick to feel irritated or angry, and easily put out when things go wrong.

facets.name: Depression
facets.measures: A tendency to low mood and discouragement. A trait name, not a diagnosis.
facets.low: Rarely feels low. Generally comfortable with self and with life.
facets.typical: Has low spells from time to time and comes out of them.
facets.high: Often feels blue or discouraged, and can be hard on self.

facets.name: Self-Consciousness
facets.measures: Unease about what others think; shyness and embarrassment.
facets.low: At ease with people. Not easily embarrassed and unbothered by attention.
facets.typical: Sometimes feels awkward in company, sometimes not.
facets.high: Easily embarrassed and sensitive to what others think. Finds it hard to approach people.

facets.name: Immoderation
facets.measures: The pull of cravings and urges, and how hard they are to resist.
facets.low: Resists temptation without much effort. Rarely overindulges.
facets.typical: Gives in to temptation sometimes and holds out at other times.
facets.high: Feels cravings strongly and finds them hard to resist. Tends to overdo what is enjoyable.

facets.name: Vulnerability
facets.measures: How well a person holds up under pressure.
facets.low: Stays clear-headed and capable in a crisis.
facets.typical: Copes with most pressure, and feels the strain when there is a lot of it.
facets.high: Feels overwhelmed under pressure, and can become flustered or panicky.

facets.name: Friendliness
facets.measures: Warmth towards other people and ease in making friends.
facets.low: Reserved with people. Does not reach out readily and keeps a certain distance.
facets.typical: Friendly enough, without making friends of everyone.
facets.high: Warm and approachable. Makes friends easily and is comfortable around people.

facets.name: Gregariousness
facets.measures: Liking for company and for crowds.
facets.low: Prefers to be alone or with a very few people. Avoids crowds and large gatherings.
facets.typical: Likes company some of the time and solitude some of the time.
facets.high: Loves company and large gatherings, and is seldom happier than among a lot of people.

facets.name: Assertiveness
facets.measures: Readiness to speak up, take charge and direct others.
facets.low: Stays in the background. Lets others lead and seldom presses a view.
facets.typical: Speaks up or takes the lead when there is reason to.
facets.high: Takes charge readily. Speaks out, directs others and likes to lead.

facets.name: Activity Level
facets.measures: Pace of life: how busy and how fast.
facets.low: Likes a leisurely pace. Takes time over things and is in no hurry.
facets.typical: Keeps a moderate pace.
facets.high: Always busy and on the go. Does a great deal and does it quickly.

facets.name: Excitement-Seeking
facets.measures: Appetite for thrills, risk and stimulation.
facets.low: Prefers calm to thrills. Avoids risk, noise and commotion.
facets.typical: Enjoys some excitement now and then.
facets.high: Loves excitement. Seeks out thrills and adventure, and is easily bored without them.

facets.name: Cheerfulness
facets.measures: How readily joy, fun and high spirits are felt.
facets.low: Not given to high spirits. Sober and not easily amused.
facets.typical: Cheerful a fair amount of the time.
facets.high: Full of joy and fun. Laughs easily and sees the bright side.

facets.name: Imagination
facets.measures: A rich inner life of fantasy and daydream.
facets.low: Keeps to facts. Seldom daydreams and has little use for fantasy.
facets.typical: Daydreams sometimes, and keeps one foot on the ground.
facets.high: Has a vivid imagination. Daydreams freely and enjoys flights of fancy.

facets.name: Artistic Interests
facets.measures: Responsiveness to art and to natural beauty.
facets.low: Not much moved by art or beauty, and little interested in them.
facets.typical: Appreciates art and beauty without making much of them.
facets.high: Loves art and beauty. Notices them everywhere and is deeply affected by them.

facets.name: Emotionality
facets.measures: Awareness of feelings, one's own and other people's.
facets.low: Pays little attention to feelings. Seldom emotional and not much given to noticing emotion in others.
facets.typical: Aware of own feelings in an ordinary way.
facets.high: Experiences emotions intensely and attends closely to them, in self and in others.

facets.name: Adventurousness
facets.measures: Liking for variety, new places and new ways of doing things.
facets.low: Likes routine and the familiar. Wary of change.
facets.typical: Likes some variety, within a settled way of life.
facets.high: Prefers variety to routine. Eager to try new things and go to new places.

facets.name: Intellect
facets.measures: Enjoyment of ideas, abstraction and difficult material. It measures interest, not ability.
facets.low: Prefers the concrete to the abstract. Avoids philosophical discussion and difficult reading.
facets.typical: Enjoys ideas in moderation.
facets.high: Loves ideas. Enjoys theory, debate and difficult reading for their own sake.

facets.name: Liberalism
facets.measures: Readiness to question authority, convention and tradition. The scale's items are worded for American politics.
facets.low: Respects tradition and authority, and prefers the established order.
facets.typical: Neither strongly traditional nor strongly given to challenging tradition.
facets.high: Inclined to question authority and convention, and to welcome change in society.

facets.name: Trust
facets.measures: Belief that other people mean well.
facets.low: Wary of people. Suspects hidden motives and is slow to take anyone on trust.
facets.typical: Trusts most people, with some caution.
facets.high: Trusts people. Assumes they mean well and believes what they say.

facets.name: Morality
facets.measures: Straightforwardness in dealing with others, as against guile.
facets.low: Willing to bend the rules, flatter or manoeuvre to get a result.
facets.typical: Generally straightforward with people.
facets.high: Candid and sincere. Would not cheat, flatter or use people to get ahead.

facets.name: Altruism
facets.measures: Concern for other people and readiness to help.
facets.low: Does not go out of the way for others, and regards requests for help as an imposition.
facets.typical: Helps others when asked or when it is needed.
facets.high: Loves to help. Concerned for others and generous with time.

facets.name: Cooperation
facets.measures: Dislike of confrontation; willingness to give way to keep the peace.
facets.low: Ready for a fight. Stands ground, argues back and does not mind a confrontation.
facets.typical: Prefers to get along and will argue when it matters.
facets.high: Dislikes confrontation. Will compromise or give way to keep the peace.

facets.name: Modesty
facets.measures: Modesty about oneself, as against a high opinion of oneself.
facets.low: Has a high opinion of self and is comfortable saying so.
facets.typical: Neither boastful nor self-effacing.
facets.high: Modest and unassuming. Dislikes being the centre of attention and does not claim to be better than others.

facets.name: Sympathy
facets.measures: Being moved by other people's needs and misfortunes.
facets.low: Not easily moved by others' troubles. Judges by what is fair and reasonable more than by pity.
facets.typical: Feels sympathy for others in an ordinary measure.
facets.high: Tender-hearted. Feels for those who are worse off and is moved to pity.

facets.name: Self-Efficacy
facets.measures: Confidence in one's own ability to get things done.
facets.low: Doubts own ability, and often feels unequal to the task.
facets.typical: Reasonably confident of handling what comes.
facets.high: Confident and capable. Expects to succeed and usually knows how to go about it.

facets.name: Orderliness
facets.measures: Liking for tidiness, routine and things in their place.
facets.low: Untidy and unbothered by it. Leaves things lying about and keeps no particular system.
facets.typical: Fairly tidy, without being particular.
facets.high: Likes order. Tidy, organised and happiest when everything is in its place.

facets.name: Dutifulness
facets.measures: Sense of obligation: keeping promises and following rules.
facets.low: Finds rules and obligations confining, and may break a promise or a rule.
facets.typical: Generally keeps promises and follows the rules.
facets.high: Strong sense of duty. Keeps promises, tells the truth and follows the rules.

facets.name: Achievement-Striving
facets.measures: Ambition and willingness to work hard for a goal.
facets.low: Content to do enough to get by. Not much driven to excel.
facets.typical: Works steadily towards goals without being consumed by them.
facets.high: Works hard and aims high. Does more than is expected and sets demanding goals.

facets.name: Self-Discipline
facets.measures: Getting started on tasks and staying with them.
facets.low: Puts things off. Has trouble starting tasks and is easily distracted from them.
facets.typical: Gets things done, with the occasional delay.
facets.high: Gets on with things at once and carries them through, however dull.

facets.name: Cautiousness
facets.measures: Thinking before acting.
facets.low: Acts on the spur of the moment, often without thinking it through.
facets.typical: Usually thinks before acting, and is sometimes impulsive.
facets.high: Deliberate. Thinks things through and avoids rash decisions.
